infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Evulto uses your camera for live form coaching (processed only on your device), physique progress photos (encrypted on your device, then scored by our AI provider), meal scans (sent to our AI provider to identify the food, not stored), and optional selfies and video reviews you keep on your device.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Evulto uses your microphone during a live coach call so the AI coach can hear you, and while you record a Video Review clip. It is never used in the background.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Evulto opens your photo library so you can pick an existing photo to use as a physique progress shot (encrypted on your device before upload) or a meal to log (sent to our AI provider to identify the food, not stored). Only the photo you choose is read.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Evulto asks for this only so iOS can offer to keep a photo you have just taken in the app in your own library. Evulto adds nothing else to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Evulto reads your steps, resting heart rate, HRV and sleep from Apple Health to work out how recovered you are each morning and to adjust that day's training load.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Evulto requests read-only Health access and does not write workouts or any other data back to Apple Health.
